normalizedScope: Publish existing accepted S03 source/evidence and its metadata closeout to configured origin/work by non-force push; create/reuse work->main PR; perform guarded merge after binding actual PR, exact expected main/head, acceptance/evidence and required checks. This is Human delegation, not PM product authority.

priorPermissionWait.disposition: New explicit Human delegation supplies previously missing publication/merge authority. Submit this source with any tool approval review. No bypass if rejected again.

mergeBinding: Delegated, but exact executable HUMAN_MERGE_CONTROL must be bound after actual PR/head and required checks are observed; no stale/unknown target merge.
exclusions: No DEC003/AC002 or unrelated dirty README/notes/references in S03 publication
No force/reset/discard, required-check bypass or repository settings change
No new product acceptance, Gate closure or PASS expansion
